name: goblin
description: a Goblin, a small hunched lime-green goblin with large pointed ears, big yellow eyes, a long hooked nose and a fanged grin, a ragged brown leather tunic and loincloth with a rope belt, bare clawed feet, and a crude wooden spear with a grey stone-and-steel head in his LEFT hand
hands: the spear stays in his left hand on the screen-right side and his right hand is an empty clawed hand on the screen-left side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back, the spear is lifted up over the head with its spearhead pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched, the spear cocked behind the head with its spearhead pointing back, the empty clawed hand tucked in
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips forward, the arm sweeps over the head and the spear is level, its spearhead pointing to the lower-right
strike.4: contact: spear arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the spearhead thrusting down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the empty clawed hand swung back for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the spear carries on down until its spearhead nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the ears trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the spear lifts back toward the ready angle

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the empty clawed hand flung out to the left, spear arm thrown up and out)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the spear dipping, the empty clawed hand still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, spear arm flung up, the empty hand drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the spear lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the spearhead resting on the ground, the empty hand hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the spear slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left; the spear lies on the ground at the lower-right
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the ears flop
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the spear on the ground beside him
